meta.name: board-deck-builder
meta.description: Assembles comprehensive board and investor update decks by pulling perspectives from all C-suite roles. Use when preparing board meetings, investor updates, quarterly business reviews, or fundraising narratives. Covers structure, narrative framework, bad news delivery, and common mistakes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成董事会和投资人汇报材料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要准备面向董事会或投资人的正式汇报材料
copy.tagline_en: Quickly assemble board and investor update decks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prepare formal presentations for board or investors

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的指标，生成包含 CEO、CFO 等所有高管视角的董事会或投资者汇报幻灯片。它按“标题→数据→叙述→下一步”结构组织，并自动填充占位符，不会编造数字。
howto.when: 当你准备董事会会议、投资者更新、季度业务回顾或融资叙事时，用自然语言说明节奏和阶段（如“季度董事会 deck，我们是 A 轮”），Claude 就会触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个季度董事会 deck，我们是 A 轮公司。
say.note: Claude 会生成标准结构的完整 deck。

say.text: 起草一份种子轮融资的投资者 deck。
say.note: Claude 会以市场/愿景开头，以融资请求结尾。

say.text: 生成一份月度董事会简报，只要指标、财务和风险部分。
say.note: Claude 会输出精简版（8-12 页）。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate board or investor update decks covering all C-suite perspectives based on metrics you provide. It follows a Headline → Data → Narrative → Ask/Next structure and fills gaps with explicit placeholders without inventing numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you prepare board meetings, investor updates, quarterly business reviews, or fundraising narratives. Use natural language specifying cadence and stage, e.g., 'Build a quarterly board deck — we're Series A.'

say_en.text: Build a quarterly board deck for a Series A company.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full deck with standard structure.

say_en.text: Draft a fundraising board deck for a seed-stage company.
say_en.note: Claude opens with market/vision and closes with the ask.

say_en.text: Create a monthly board update with metrics, financials, and risks only.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a condensed 8-12 slide version.
